invalidation.reason: A daily close below the November 25 low breaks the rebound thesis. A delivery cut or materially worse financing terms would also change the call.

signals.text: Q4 guidance implies $747M–$847M of adjusted operating profit against $1.05B–$1.15B of interest expense.
Management expected about $9B of customer funds over three months from November 10. The amount collected is still open.
Shares recovered from $37.40 to close at $42.57 on November 25, below the $48.33 close two sessions earlier.
